stem: A student traveled a distance of 68 miles in 136 minutes. Which graph has a slope that best represents this rate?

options.label: A
options.text: Graph A with a line from (0,0) to about (4,9)

options.label: B
options.text: Graph B with a line from (1,2) to about (9,9)

options.label: C
options.text: Graph C with a line from (0,0) to about (9,5)

options.label: D
options.text: Graph D with a line from (0,1) horizontal to about (9,1)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, D with axes labeled 'Time (minutes)' on x-axis from 0 to 9 and 'Distance (miles)' on y-axis from 0 to 9
Graph A line steeply rising from (0,0) to near (4,9)
Graph B line rising from near (1,2) to near (9,9)
Graph C line rising gently from (0,0) to near (9,5)
Graph D line flat near y=1 from (0,1) to (9,1)
notes: The problem asks to identify the graph whose slope best matches the rate 68 miles/136 minutes = 0.5 miles/minute approximately. Graph C's slope approximates this rate best.
